sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今天的主要事件：

  • Intel announced a $15 billion common stock offering (equivalent to approximately 150 million new shares at a share price above $100) to fund capital expenditures for foundry and AI capacity. INTC fell more than 3% premarket to around $96.4, making it the most direct catalyst for this morning’s semiconductor weakness; the community linked it to a broader “dilution wave” involving GOOGL and bond issuance by various neocloud companies.
  • Archer Aviation acquired Boeing’s eVTOL assets: it will take over Wisk Aero, Insitu, and SkyGrid, while Boeing will receive a nearly 20% equity stake, provide up to $55 million in follow-on investment, and gain the right to nominate a director; Insitu generates more than $200 million in annual revenue. ACHR traded at $6.60 premarket, up approximately 26%, making it this morning’s strongest-performing small- or mid-cap stock.
  • Meta released the open-weight model Muse Glimmer, which can run locally on a single-GPU laptop; Zuckerberg simultaneously published a 14-page essay titled The Future is for Everyone and established a $1 billion data center community fund. META moved back above $600 premarket, trading near $602. During the same period, Jefferies downgraded AAPL to Underperform with a $263.66 price target, reportedly because the all-glass iPhone project had been canceled. AAPL closed Friday at $313.29 and was under pressure premarket.
  • JPMorgan raised its year-end S&P 500 target from 7800 to 8000, with 2026/2027 EPS forecasts of $365/$420, citing the conversion of AI backlogs into revenue. The S&P 500 closed Friday at 7757.64, while SPY closed at 773.16; at least seven institutions now have targets of 8000.
  • Hormuz remains in a “clopen” state: the Iran-Oman technical agreement on the shipping channel has entered its final stage, but Iran is demanding that the U.S. cease hostilities, withdraw its troops, and pay compensation. Reports suggest Trump is preparing to “declare victory once the strait reopens” and may even consider withdrawing without reaching a nuclear agreement. USO closed Friday at $118.02, and oil prices have not collapsed on expectations of peace. RKLB and ASTS report earnings after today’s close, Micron speaks at the KeyBanc forum at 10:00 ET, and CPI plus NBIS earnings are scheduled for 8/12.

社区氛围：总体而言，市场“指数层面适度看涨，但个股层面极度分化”。大多数人认为 SPY 只是在 CPI 之前横向盘整，但内存股持有者已经进入公开投降和自嘲的阶段，而太空/eVTOL 股票在盘前被追捧得更高。市场情绪已从上周的广泛反弹狂潮转变为行业内的残酷轮动。

WSB 情绪与实际价格走势：明显不匹配。社区将 SPY 盘前 0.05% - 0.08% 的下跌称为“黑色星期一”，尽管该指数上周五刚刚触及新高区域。相反，被社会一致宣布“死亡”的内存领域确实正在走弱。这一次，大众判断和价格走势正朝着同一方向发展——这本身就值得谨慎，因为 WSB 共识通常出现在中期极端情况附近。
